title: Chinese paper lamps
description: Spout plugin that adds Chinese paper lamps.
body:
Chinese paper lamps
(for Spout)

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1091830813240348732?color=5865F2&label=discord&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/EduvcVmKS7) ![1.21.11](https://img.shields.io/badge/Latest_version-26.1.2-4fa31a?style=for-the-badge)
## Introduction A plugin that adds fully server-side Chinese paper lamps, lit and unlit. * An unlit lamp can be crafted from 4 paper * A lit lamp can be crafted from 4 paper and a torch, or from an unlit lamp and a torch * Paper lamps serve as decoration or lighting!
## Installation Place the `.jar` file into the `plugins` folder. This plugin requires [Spout](https://github.com/ModernSpout/Spout), a server extension of Paper.
